article.title: Concordancia con sustantivos colectivos en BrE/AmE
article.part: Registro, variación y norma — Register, variation, and standard usage
article.chapter: Variedades del inglés — Varieties of English

claims.summary: A collective noun such as team, family or government denotes a group, and its verbal agreement may reflect the group as a unit (singular agreement) or its members as individuals (plural/notional agreement). Both readings can occur in British English; American English generally shows a stronger preference for singular verb agreement with morphologically singular collectives, with lexical and contextual exceptions.

links.notes: Registered reference supports grammatical versus notional subject–verb agreement of collectives, including regional variation.
